entities.name: Hand of Justice
entities.description: An avatar of law on Dominaria, an embodiment of the ideal of justice that is content with only meting out justice; avatars were summoned in Sarpadia and in Ki'pamu.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Hand of Justice is an avatar of law.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: A continent of Dominaria where a Hand of Justice was summoned.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: A nation on the continent of Sarpadia where a Hand of Justice was present just before the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: The collapse of the empires of Sarpadia, shortly after which a Hand of Justice was present in Icatia.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: A figure who may have summoned the Sarpadian Hand of Justice.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: A city where the Civic guild summoned a Hand of Justice and where another was later summoned to stop crime.

entities.name: Civic guild
entities.description: A guild in Ki'pamu that summoned a Hand of Justice.

entities.name: Tartesk Hajeen
entities.description: Man who summoned a Hand of Justice to stop crime in Ki'pamu; uncle of Sabul Hajeen.

entities.name: Sabul Hajeen
entities.description: Tartesk's nephew, who allied with his family's arch-enemy Jhossendea Ilmiera to banish the Hand of Justice.

entities.name: Jhossendea Ilmiera
entities.description: A necromancer and arch-enemy of the Hajeen family who helped Sabul Hajeen banish the Hand of Justice.

events.summary: A Hand of Justice is present in Icatia just before the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires, possibly summoned by Oliver Farrel; its actions are unknown.
Millennia later Tartesk Hajeen summons a Hand of Justice to stop crime in Ki'pamu.
events.quote: Millennia later, another Hand of Justice was summoned by Tartesk Hajeen to stop crime in the city of Ki'pamu

events.summary: The avatar starts indiscriminately targeting the city's poor; Sabul Hajeen allies with Jhossendea Ilmiera and together they banish it, beginning to mend the enmity between their families.
events.quote: Together, the two of them managed to banish the Hand of Justice

relations.quote: another Hand of Justice was summoned by Tartesk Hajeen
saw no other option but to ally himself with his family's arch-enemy
